title: Tryforce optimizations
description: This is a project that aims to make Minecraft run well on any computer. While still adding a nice touch of QoL and visual enhancements.
body:
# **✨ About This Project**
**This modpack is a curated, performance-focused Fabric setup designed to provide a stable, optimized, and enhanced Minecraft experience. It combines backend optimizations, rendering improvements, quality-of-life upgrades, and optional visual features into a cohesive configuration.**
## Content
### 🚀 Performance & Optimization
- Rendering optimization (Sodium, Sodium Extra, Reese’s Sodium Options)
- Memory and entity optimization (Lithium, FerriteCore, Clumps, Entity Culling, More Culling)
- Threading and chunk performance improvements (C2ME, ThreadTweak)
- Network and packet optimizations (Krypton, Fast IP Ping)
- Faster startup and shutdown (ImmediatelyFast, FastQuit)
- Dynamic performance scaling (Dynamic FPS)
- Removal of resource reload interruption (Remove Reloading Screen)
### 🎨 Visual & Rendering Enhancements
- Shader support (Iris)
- Dynamic lighting (LambDynamicLights)
- Entity model & texture enhancements (EMF, ETF)
- Enhanced capes & animations (WaveyCapes, Not Enough Animations)
- Custom skyboxes (Skyboxify)
- Zoom functionality (Zoomify)

_All visual features remain configurable depending on hardware capability._
### 🧩 Quality of Life & UI Improvements
- Advanced keybind management (Controlling)
- Enhanced mod configuration (Mod Menu, YACL, Cloth Config)
- Improved statistics & chat management
- Mouse Tweaks
- Resource pack management (Resourcify)
### 🗺️ Utility & Multiplayer Features
- Xaero’s Minimap
- Xaero’s World Map
- Open Parties and Claims
- Custom Skin Loader & 3D Skin Layers
### 🔧 Core Libraries & Compatibility
Includes all required Fabric libraries and compatibility APIs to ensure stability, proper dependency resolution, and clean configuration management.
